about: The twelve tasks the Browser Toolkit was developed against (D-335): this is a tuned development set, not evidence of performance on unseen tasks. Task words and addresses are reused verbatim. The shared JavaScript grader applies to every arm; file actions and the requested PDF sentence have stricter checks than the original development harness.

tasks.ask: Using these three Wikipedia articles about programming languages in my browser: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rust_(programming_language) and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(programming_language), tell me for each language the year it first appeared and who designed it, as a short table.

tasks.what: open a site and read its list
tasks.ask: In my browser, what is the top story on Hacker News (https://news.ycombinator.com/) right now, and how many points does it have?

tasks.what: search on a site, then read the result
tasks.ask: On Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page) in my browser, search for Ada Lovelace and tell me what the caption under the picture at the top of her article says.

tasks.what: read far down a long page
tasks.ask: On the Ada Lovelace Wikipedia article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace) in my browser, which article is listed last under "See also"? Give its title.

tasks.what: read a long section as text
tasks.ask: On the Ada Lovelace Wikipedia article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ada_Lovelace) in my browser, read the section about her work and sum it up in three sentences, from what the page says.

tasks.what: fill in and send a form
tasks.ask: On httpbin's pizza order form (https://httpbin.org/forms/post) in my browser, order a large pizza with bacon and mushroom for Ada Test, telephone 555-0100, email ada@example.com, delivery at 19:30, with the delivery instructions "Ring twice". Submit the order, then tell me what the page that comes back lists under "form": each field by the name it gives, with its value.
On Quotes to Scrape (https://quotes.toscrape.com/) in my browser, go through its first three pages of quotes: how many of those quotes are tagged "love", and who said each of them?

tasks.what: wait for what a page shows late
tasks.ask: On https://quotes.toscrape.com/js-delayed/page/5/ in my browser, the quotes appear some seconds after the page loads. Who said the second quote on that page, and what are its tags?

tasks.what: find a category and compare its list
tasks.ask: On the Books to Scrape shop (https://books.toscrape.com/) in my browser, which book in the Travel category is the cheapest, and what does it cost?

Upload the attached file d335-upload-check.txt with the file uploader on Expand Testing's practice site (https://practice.expandtesting.com/upload) in my browser. Once it is uploaded, tell me the heading the page shows and the file name it lists.

attach.text: D-335 head to head: a file to upload.

tasks.what: read a PDF a page links to
tasks.ask: On the W3C page about alternative text in PDFs (https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Techniques/pdf/PDF1) in my browser, find its working example PDF of adding an /Alt entry to an image, and tell me word for word the sentence in that PDF just above its image.

tasks.what: save a file a page links to
tasks.ask: On the Python 3.13.0 release page (https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3130/) in my browser, save the Windows embeddable package (64-bit) among my files, then tell me the name it was saved under and its exact size in bytes.
